Caveat: this only adds `androidx.profileinstaller:profileinstaller:1.4.1` to `app/build.gradle.kts`, which lets the app install a baseline profile on device. It does not fully fix P11. There is still no `baseline-prof.txt` in `app/src/main`, and no Baseline Profile generator module or `androidx.baselineprofile` plugin. Those need changes outside this file (root `build.gradle.kts`, `settings.gradle.kts`, and a new module), and I did not make them. I also could not build the project here to confirm the dependency resolves.
